title: Knowledge-graph node → name, title, description and summary (kg-export, fsh-guts-export)
description: The four naming keys every node of a published knowledge-graph document may carry, and the predicate each one is. Both scripts/kg-export.ts and scripts/fsh-guts-export.ts DERIVE their @context bindings for these keys from this table, so fsh-guts' claim to map name and description 'exactly as the main export' is structural rather than a comment (finding D2 of docs/proposals/vocabulary-mappings-2026-10-02.md, bean lodp). description is dcterms:description and title dcterms:title since bean xsqm (owner, 2026-09-30: 'emphasize preexisting standards'). Three groups rather than two so the derived @context keeps kg-export's key order. A schema module's first docblock line is written under `summary` like every other node's, and its title is the module stem (finding D5, owner 2026-10-02: 'Make it like the others').
